== Notes ==
* Burning is refreshed every second that Ray of Judgment is active, e.g. a stationary target might burn as long as 7 seconds from a ray cast with a Smiting Prayers rank of 12 to 18.

{{Anomaly|Unlike other recurring ground AOE skills, AI units often will not try to leave until the effect is nearly expired.}}

== Trivia ==
* This is the only monk skill that can inflict a condition on foes.
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill history]] for details.
